title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: City of Gosnells Local Government Property Local Law 2009

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 74, 6 May 2011, Gazette No. 87, 27 May 2011, Gazette No. 87, 27 May 2011, Gazette No. 89, 31 May 2011, Gazette No. 89, 31 May 2011, Gazette No. 27, 25 Feb 2020, Gazette No. 1, 7 Jan 2025); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Advertising signs in public places need the council's permit.
